# Import necessary packages

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
```

# Variables and variable-details sheet

Note: remember to save below files as "CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)(.csv)"

```{r}
variables <- read.csv("Worksheets/raw_variables.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("","NA","N/A"))
names(variables)[1] <- "Phase" # remove some strange characters for encoding

variable_details <- read.csv("Worksheets/raw_variable_details.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("","NA","N/A"))
names(variable_details)[1] <- "Phase" # remove some strange characters for encoding

smell_key <- read.csv("Raw data/Olfactory_UPSIT_neuroscent_key.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("","NA","N/A"))
```

# Read data and data preparation

```{r}
data_1 <- read.csv("Raw data/results-survey253942.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("",".","NA", "N/A"))
variables_1 <- variables %>% filter(Phase == "PREDIGT 1.0")
variable_details_1 <- variable_details %>% filter(Phase == "PREDIGT 1.0")

# update variable names
names(data_1) <- variables_1$Short.name
```

## make sure the labels match the variable_detail sheet

```{r, warning=FALSE}
flag_print <- F
for (var in unique(variable_details_1$Short.name)) {
  vec1 <- sort(as.vector(unlist(unique(data_1[var]))))
  vec2 <- sort(as.vector(unlist(variable_details_1 %>% filter(Short.name==var) %>% select(OptionLabel))))
  
  if (!all(vec1==vec2) & flag_print) {
    print(var)
    print(vec1)
    print(vec2)
  }
}
```

## make the categorical variables as factor and make the labels shorter if applicable

```{r}
flag_print <- F
for (var in unique(variable_details_1$Short.name)) {
  if (flag_print) {
    print("-------------")
    print(table(data_1[var], useNA = "ifany"))
  }
  label_vec <- as.vector(unlist(variable_details_1 %>% filter(Short.name==var) %>% select(OptionLabel)))
  label_vec <- label_vec[!is.na(label_vec)]
  
  label_vec_2 <- as.vector(unlist(variable_details_1 %>% filter(Short.name==var) %>% select(ShortLabel)))
  label_vec_2 <- label_vec_2[!is.na(label_vec_2)]
  
  if (!all(label_vec==label_vec_2)) # need to make the labels shorter
  {
    vec <- unlist(data_1[var])
    for (i in seq_len(length(label_vec))){
      vec[which(vec == label_vec[i])] <- label_vec_2[i]
    }
    data_1[var] <- vec
  }
  
  # make it factor with proper levels
  data_1[names(data_1)[which(names(data_1) == var)]] <- 
    lapply(data_1[names(data_1)[which(names(data_1) == var)]], factor, levels = label_vec_2)
  if (flag_print) {
    print(table(data_1[var], useNA = "ifany"))
    print(lapply(data_1[names(data_1)[which(names(data_1) == var)]], levels))
  }
}
```

# remove unfinished and repeated entries

The page for RBD is 18. So include entries if lastPage >= 19

```{r}
table(data_1$lastPage)

# Completed
data_1 <- data_1 %>% filter(lastPage >= 19) 
dim(data_1)
length(unique(data_1$ID))
```

For participants who have completed multiple times, only keep the last and most complete one

```{r}
df <- data_1 %>% 
  group_by(ID, lastPage) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()
table(df$count)
```

# Go through each variable, more curation if needed

```{r}
data_diagnosis <- read.csv("Raw data/Final diagnosis.csv", header = TRUE, na.strings=c("",".","NA", "N/A"))
data_1 <- data_1 %>% left_join(data_diagnosis %>% select(ID, diagnosis_final), by = "ID")
table(data_1$diagnosis_final, useNA = "ifany")
length(unique(data_1$ID))

data_1 <- data_1 %>% filter(diagnosis_final != "remove")
length(unique(data_1$ID))

data_1$diagnosis <- ifelse(data_1$diagnosis_final %in% c("MSA", "MSA, mixed type", "MSA-C", "MSA-P"), "MSA", data_1$diagnosis_final)
table(data_1$diagnosis, useNA = "ifany")

data_1 <- data_1 %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(diagnosis == "HC", "HC",
                         ifelse(diagnosis %in% c("DLB", "PD"), "PD/DLB", "Other")),
         group2 = case_when(
           diagnosis == "HC" ~ "HC", 
           diagnosis %in% c("PD", "DLB") ~ "PD/DLB", 
           diagnosis %in% c("MSA", "PSP") ~ "MSA/PSP", 
           diagnosis %in% c("AD", "Dementia", "MCI") ~ "MCI/DEM", 
           TRUE ~ "AON" # All Other Neurological Diseases
         ))

table(data_1 %>% select(diagnosis, group), useNA = "ifany")
table(data_1 %>% select(diagnosis, group2), useNA = "ifany")
table(data_1 %>% select(diagnosis_self, group), useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
# Age at diagnosis/symptom and duration of disease
diagnosisTime <- data_1 %>% select(ID, lastActDate, age, contains("diagnosis"), contains("symptom")) %>% 
  mutate(visitYear =  year(lastActDate),
         diagnosis_age_dir = ifelse(!is.na(diagnosis_age), diagnosis_age,
                                    ifelse(!is.na(diagnosis_year), age - (visitYear - diagnosis_year), NA)),
         symptom_age_dir = ifelse(!is.na(symptom_age), symptom_age,
                                  ifelse(!is.na(symptom_year), age - (visitYear - symptom_year), NA)),
         disease_duration = age - diagnosis_age_dir)

summary(diagnosisTime)

data_1 <- data_1 %>% 
  mutate(visitYear = diagnosisTime$visitYear,
         diagnosis_age_dir = diagnosisTime$diagnosis_age_dir,
         symptom_age_dir = diagnosisTime$symptom_age_dir,
         disease_duration = diagnosisTime$disease_duration) %>% 
  mutate(diagnosis_age_dir = ifelse(group == "HC", NA, diagnosis_age_dir),
         symptom_age_dir = ifelse(group == "HC", NA, symptom_age_dir),
         disease_duration = ifelse(group == "HC", NA, disease_duration))

table(data_1 %>% select(disease_duration, group))
data_1 %>% filter(disease_duration==57)

# The patient PP139 has Gauchers for 57 years. Disease duration of PD is unclear
data_1$disease_duration[which(data_1$disease_duration == 57)] <- NA
```

```{r}
## race
race <- data_1 %>% select(ID, contains("race")) 

race$race5[which(race$race_which == "Half Asian Half White")] <- "Yes" # Asian
race$race7[which(race$race_which == "Half Asian Half White")] <- "Yes" # White

race <- race %>% 
  mutate(race1 = ifelse(is.na(race1), NA, ifelse(race1 == "Yes", 1, 0)),
         race2 = ifelse(is.na(race2), NA, ifelse(race2 == "Yes", 1, 0)),
         race3 = ifelse(is.na(race3), NA, ifelse(race3 == "Yes", 1, 0)),
         race4 = ifelse(is.na(race4), NA, ifelse(race4 == "Yes", 1, 0)),
         race5 = ifelse(is.na(race5), NA, ifelse(race5 == "Yes", 1, 0)),
         race6 = ifelse(is.na(race6), NA, ifelse(race6 == "Yes", 1, 0)),
         race7 = ifelse(is.na(race7), NA, ifelse(race7 == "Yes", 1, 0)),
         race_other = ifelse(is.na(race_other), NA, ifelse(race_other == "Yes", 1, 0))) %>% 
  mutate(race1_dir = ifelse(is.na(race1), "", ifelse(race1 == 1, "Ashkenazi Jewish, ", "")),
         race2_dir = ifelse(is.na(race2), "", ifelse(race2 == 1, "Basque, ", "")),
         race3_dir = ifelse(is.na(race3), "", ifelse(race3 == 1, "African Berber, ", "")),
         race4_dir = ifelse(is.na(race4), "", ifelse(race4 == 1, "Indigenous Peoples in Canada (the First Nations, Inuit and Métis), ", "")),
         race5_dir = ifelse(is.na(race5), "", ifelse(race5 == 1, "Asian, ", "")),
         race6_dir = ifelse(is.na(race6), "", ifelse(race6 == 1, "Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander, ", "")),
         race7_dir = ifelse(is.na(race7), "", ifelse(race7 == 1, "White", "")))
race$race_combine <- paste0(race$race1_dir, race$race2_dir, race$race3_dir, race$race4_dir, race$race5_dir, race$race6_dir, race$race7_dir)
unique(race$race_combine)
table(race$race_combine, useNA = "ifany")

race <- race %>% 
  mutate(race_combine = case_when(
    race_combine == "" ~ "Did not choose offered options",
    race_combine == "Asian, " ~ "Asian",
    race_combine == "Ashkenazi Jewish, " ~ "Ashkenazi Jewish",
    TRUE ~ race_combine
  ))
table(race$race_combine, useNA = "ifany")

names(race)
nNA <- rowSums(as.matrix(is.na(race[,c(2:8)])))
nYes <- rowSums(as.matrix(race[,c(2:8)]), na.rm = T)
race <- race %>% mutate(nNA = nNA,
                        nYes = nYes)
table(race$nNA, useNA = "ifany")
table(race$nYes, useNA = "ifany")

race <- race %>% 
  mutate(race = case_when(
    nYes == 0 & is.na(race_which) ~  "Did not answer",
    nYes > 1   ~ "Multi-racial",
    race1 == 1 ~ "Ashkenazi Jewish",
    race2 == 1 ~ "Basque",
    race3 == 1 ~ "African Berber",
    race4 == 1 ~ "Indigenous Peoples in Canada (the First Nations, Inuit and Métis)",
    race5 == 1 ~ "Asian",
    race6 == 1 ~ "Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander",
    race7 == 1 ~ "White",
    nYes == 0 & !is.na(race_which) ~ paste0("Other, ", race_which)
  )) %>% 
  mutate(race_combine = ifelse(race_combine == "Did not choose offered options", race, race_combine)) %>% 
  mutate(race2 = ifelse(race_combine == "White", "White",
                        ifelse(race_combine == "Did not answer", "Did not answer", "Non-white")))

table(race$race, useNA = "ifany")
table(race$race, race$race_combine, useNA = "ifany")

data_1$race_dir <- race$race_combine
data_1$race_dir2 <- race$race2
table(data_1$race_dir, useNA = "ifany")
table(data_1$race_dir, data_1$race_dir2, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
# constipation
data_1$constipation_dir <- as.numeric(data_1$constipation) - 1
data_1 <- data_1 %>% 
  mutate(constipation_dir_b = ifelse(is.na(constipation), NA,
                                     ifelse(constipation == "Never/Not Applicable", 0, 1)),
         constipation_dir_m = ifelse(is.na(constipation), NA,
                                     ifelse(constipation == "Never/Not Applicable", 0, 
                                            ifelse(constipation == "Sometimes", 1, 2))))
table(data_1$constipation, data_1$constipation_dir, useNA = "ifany")
table(data_1$constipation, data_1$constipation_dir_b, useNA = "ifany")
table(data_1$constipation, data_1$constipation_dir_m, useNA = "ifany")

# duration of constipation
table(data_1$constipation_duration_unit, useNA = "ifany")
data_1 <- data_1 %>% 
  mutate(constipation_duration_clean_years = ifelse(is.na(constipation_duration_clean_num), NA, 
                                                    case_when(
                                                      constipation_duration_unit == "Days"  ~ constipation_duration_clean_num / 365,
                                                      constipation_duration_unit == "Weeks"  ~ constipation_duration_clean_num / 52,
                                                      constipation_duration_unit == "Months"  ~ constipation_duration_clean_num / 12,
                                                      constipation_duration_unit == "Years"  ~ constipation_duration_clean_num
                                                    )),
         constipation_before_diagnosis = ifelse(group == "HC", NA,
                                                ifelse(is.na(constipation_duration_clean_years), NA,
                                                       ifelse(constipation_duration_clean_years > disease_duration, 1, 0)))) %>% 
  mutate(constipation_duration_before_diagnosis = ifelse(is.na(constipation_before_diagnosis), NA,
                                                         ifelse(constipation_before_diagnosis == 0, NA,
                                                                constipation_duration_clean_years - disease_duration)))
summary(data_1$constipation_duration_clean_years)
table(data_1 %>% filter(!is.na(constipation_duration_clean_years)) %>% select(group), useNA = "ifany")
table(data_1$constipation_before_diagnosis, useNA = "ifany")
summary(data_1$constipation_duration_before_diagnosis)
```

```{r}
data_1 <- data_1 %>% 
  mutate(
    # Only set as "Yes" if participants chose "Yes, without known cause"
    olfaction_dir = ifelse(is.na(olfaction_self), NA,
                           ifelse(olfaction_self == "Yes, without known cause", 1, 0)),
    # Only set as "No" if participants chose No"
    olfaction_dir2 = ifelse(is.na(olfaction_self), NA,
                            ifelse(olfaction_self == "No", 0, 1)))

# One participant chose "Other" and the reason was "During a maigraine my sense of smell is very acute"
data_1$olfaction_dir2[grepl("acute", data_1$olfaction_other)] <- 0

table(data_1$olfaction_self, data_1$olfaction_dir, useNA = "ifany")

# duration of olfaction loss

data_1 <- data_1 %>% 
  mutate(olfaction_duration_clean_years = ifelse(is.na(olfaction_duration_clean_num), NA, 
                                                 case_when(
                                                   olfaction_duration_unit == "Days"  ~ olfaction_duration_clean_num / 365,
                                                   olfaction_duration_unit == "Weeks"  ~ olfaction_duration_clean_num / 52,
                                                   olfaction_duration_unit == "Months"  ~ olfaction_duration_clean_num / 12,
                                                   olfaction_duration_unit == "Years"  ~ olfaction_duration_clean_num
                                                 )),
         olfaction_before_diagnosis = ifelse(group == "HC", NA,
                                             ifelse(is.na(olfaction_duration_clean_years), NA,
                                                    ifelse(olfaction_duration_clean_years > disease_duration, 1, 0)))) %>% 
  mutate(olfaction_duration_before_diagnosis = ifelse(is.na(olfaction_before_diagnosis), NA,

                                                             olfaction_duration_clean_years - disease_duration)))
```

```{r}
# Smoking
data_1 <- data_1 %>% 
  mutate(smoke_dir = ifelse(smoke == "No", "Never smoked",
                            ifelse(smoke_now == "Yes.", "Current smoking", "Past smoking")),
         smoke_dir2 = case_when(
           smoke_now == "Yes." & smoke_duration >= 20 ~ 12,
           smoke_now == "Yes." & smoke_duration > 10 ~ 8,
           smoke == "Yes" & smoke_duration >= 20 ~ 4,

           smoke == "Yes" ~ 1,
           TRUE ~ 0
         ))
```

## Genetic

The participant with Garcher disease knows her GBA mutation.

## UPSIT persentile

```{r}
upsit_norm <- read.csv("Raw data/UPSIT norm.csv", header = T, na.strings=c("",".","NA", "N/A"))
upsit_norm[is.na(upsit_norm)] <- 4
upsit_norm_long <- upsit_norm %>% pivot_longer(-c(UPSIT, sex), names_to = "age_cat", values_to = "UPSIT_percentile")
upsit_norm_long$age_cat <- factor(upsit_norm_long$age_cat, levels = c("X35.39", "X40.44", "X45.49", "X50.54", "X55.59", "X60.64", "X65.69", "X70.74", "X75.79", "X80.84", "over85"))
levels(upsit_norm_long$age_cat) <- c("35-39", "40-44", "45-49", "50-54", "55-59", "60-64", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79", "80-84", "over85")
upsit_norm_long$ref <- paste(upsit_norm_long$sex, upsit_norm_long$age_cat, upsit_norm_long$UPSIT, sep = "_")
```

```{r}
upsit_percentile <- UPSIT %>% select(ID, UPSIT_scr) %>% left_join(data_1 %>% select(ID, sex, age), by = "ID")
upsit_percentile <- upsit_percentile %>% mutate(age_cat = ifelse(is.na(age), NA, case_when(
  age < 40 ~ "35-39",
  age < 45 ~ "40-44",
  age < 50 ~ "45-49",
  age < 55 ~ "50-54",
  age < 60 ~ "55-59",
  age < 65 ~ "60-64",
  age < 70 ~ "65-69",
  age < 75 ~ "70-74",
  age < 80 ~ "75-79",
  age < 85 ~ "80-84",
  TRUE ~ "over85"
)))
upsit_percentile$ref <- paste(upsit_percentile$sex, upsit_percentile$age_cat, upsit_percentile$UPSIT_scr, sep = "_")

upsit_percentile <- upsit_percentile %>% left_join(upsit_norm_long %>% select(ref, UPSIT_percentile), by = "ref")

UPSIT <- UPSIT %>% left_join(upsit_percentile %>% select(ID, UPSIT_percentile), by = "ID")
UPSIT <- UPSIT %>% 
  mutate(olfaction =ifelse(is.na(UPSIT_percentile), NA,
                           ifelse(UPSIT_percentile <= 15, "Reduced", "Normal"))) # DOI: 10.1002/mds.24892
```

# NeuroScent: PREDIGT 2.0

```{r}
data_2 <- read.csv("Raw data/results-survey633248.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("",".","NA", "N/A"))

variables_2 <- variables %>% filter(Phase == "PREDIGT 2.0")
variable_details_2 <- variable_details %>% filter(Phase == "PREDIGT 2.0")

# update variable names
names(data_2) <- variables_2$Short.name
```

## make sure the labels match the variable_detail sheet

```{r, warning=FALSE}
flag_print <- F
for (var in unique(variable_details_2$Short.name)) {
  vec1 <- sort(as.vector(unlist(unique(data_2[var]))))
  vec2 <- sort(as.vector(unlist(variable_details_2 %>% filter(Short.name==var) %>% select(OptionLabel))))
  
  if (!all(vec1==vec2) & flag_print) {
    print(var)
    print(vec1)
    print(vec2)
  }
}
```

## make the categorical variables as factor and make the labels shorter if applicable

```{r}
flag_print <- F
for (var in unique(variable_details_2$Short.name)) {
  if (flag_print) {
    print("-------------")
    print(table(data_2[var], useNA = "ifany"))
  }
  label_vec <- as.vector(unlist(variable_details_2 %>% filter(Short.name==var) %>% select(OptionLabel)))
  label_vec <- label_vec[!is.na(label_vec)]
  
  label_vec_2 <- as.vector(unlist(variable_details_2 %>% filter(Short.name==var) %>% select(ShortLabel)))
  label_vec_2 <- label_vec_2[!is.na(label_vec_2)]
  
  if (!all(label_vec==label_vec_2)) # need to make the labels shorter
  {
    vec <- unlist(data_2[var])
    for (i in seq_len(length(label_vec))){
      vec[which(vec == label_vec[i])] <- label_vec_2[i]
    }
    data_2[var] <- vec
  }
  
  # make it factor with proper levels
  data_2[names(data_2)[which(names(data_2) == var)]] <- 
    lapply(data_2[names(data_2)[which(names(data_2) == var)]], factor, levels = label_vec_2)
  if (flag_print) {
    print(table(data_2[var], useNA = "ifany"))
    print(lapply(data_2[names(data_2)[which(names(data_2) == var)]], levels))
  }
}
```

```{r}
table(data_2$fatigue, useNA = "ifany")
table(data_2$handwriting, useNA = "ifany")
table(data_2$slowness, useNA = "ifany")

data_2 <- data_2 %>% 
  mutate(fatigue_dir = ifelse(is.na(fatigue), NA,
                             ifelse(fatigue == "Normal", 0, 1)),
         handwriting_dir = ifelse(is.na(handwriting), NA,
                             ifelse(handwriting == "Normal", 0, 1)),
         slowness_dir = ifelse(is.na(slowness), NA,
                             ifelse(slowness == "Normal", 0, 1)),
         fatigue_dir_m = ifelse(is.na(fatigue), NA,
                             ifelse(fatigue == "Normal", 0, 
                                    ifelse(fatigue %in% c("Slight", "Mild"), 1, 2))),
         handwriting_dir_m = ifelse(is.na(handwriting), NA,
                             ifelse(handwriting == "Normal", 0, 
                                    ifelse(handwriting %in% c("Slight", "Mild"), 1, 2))),
         slowness_dir_m = ifelse(is.na(slowness), NA,
                             ifelse(slowness == "Normal", 0, 
                                    ifelse(slowness %in% c("Slight", "Mild"), 1, 2))))

table(data_2$fatigue, data_2$fatigue_dir, useNA = "ifany")
table(data_2$handwriting, data_2$handwriting_dir, useNA = "ifany")
table(data_2$slowness, data_2$slowness_dir, useNA = "ifany")
table(data_2$fatigue, data_2$fatigue_dir_m, useNA = "ifany")
table(data_2$handwriting, data_2$handwriting_dir_m, useNA = "ifany")
table(data_2$slowness, data_2$slowness_dir_m, useNA = "ifany")
```
